item.title: Create a Winning 30/60/90 Plan 🎯 • Set clear, measurable goals for each phase. • Align goals with company objectives. • Use: “I will achieve X by implementing Y.” • Include specific metrics to track progress. • Review and adjust as needed for relevance.
